summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting a September 30, 2026 securities purchase agreement with a single institutional investor for 250,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.00 per share and pre-funded warrants for 1,750,000 shares at $0.99 each, exercisable at $0.01. The offering closed October 1, 2026, raising approximately $2.0 million gross for working capital, via a Form F-3 shelf takedown. Univest Securities served as exclusive placement agent with a 7% cash fee. Officers and directors signed 90-day lock-ups. This is an ordinary registered shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for warrant overhang and dilution risk.
